Interface Report

All Known Implementing Classes:
ReportJson
public interface Report
A generated report in the Report Center (Reports v1 downloadable-report for the list view, report for the detail view).

The list view (getReports) populates the downloadable-report fields; the detail view (getReportById) additionally populates the richer report fields (createdBy, createdDate, startTime, endTime, errorMessage, location, numberOfAttempts, parameters). Fields not present in a given response are null.
